tablet.notes:
A search icon next to Call in every conversation and group: Images, Videos, Links and Phone numbers, or words in the messages.
Phone numbers in messages are blue like links; tap one and it asks if you want to call it.
Since the last update: voice messages and videos download when they arrive; Resize screens takes effect at once.
